title: Digital Intent Node
description: A high-level biological intent (e.g., 'dose compound X at 10µM to well A3') that the orchestrator compiles to a protocol

node_id.description: Globally unique identifier for this intent node

parameters.description: Intent-specific parameters (reagent, volume, target, temperature, duration, etc.)

created_at_ms.description: Unix timestamp (milliseconds) when this intent was created

created_by.description: Actor identity (capability token subject) that created this intent

parent_intent_id.description: Optional parent intent for hierarchical decomposition

metadata.description: Free-form metadata for experiment tracking, tags, etc.
